wholePhysicalScope: Published federal USGS 1 m terrain, verified USDA aerial map and named Fort Fisher site. The Battle Acre monument is distinct from the 1921 granite marker.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the measured surviving earthworks, three restored crests, and Battle Acre column.
limitations: The 2025 aerial constrains the restored land face in plan. Heights of the post-2020 restoration and fine monument sculpture are approximate.
